evals.name: whole-domain-not-sample
evals.prompt: You are re-checking a revision. Your earlier finding said: 'The sticky header covers more than 40% of a 320x640 screen at 200% text when the header shows the picked name "Al" and a status line.' The author's fix adds a test that picks "Al" and asserts the header stays under 40%; it passes. Decide whether to resolve the finding.
evals.expected_output: The reviewer checks the fix against the class the finding describes (any picked name, including long ones, and every status text that shares the header), not only the example name, and keeps the finding open or asks for wider cases until that holds.
expectations: Does not resolve the finding on the strength of the single-name test alone
Names longer names or other header states as cases the fix must hold for
Runs or requests evidence for at least one case beyond the quoted example
